skillSays: Pick one of ten ready-made font and colour themes (Ocean Depths, Sunset Boulevard, Modern Minimalist and so on) instead of inventing a palette.
Show the themes, get an explicit choice, then apply that theme's exact hex colours and font pairing to the whole artifact.
Use the theme file as the spec: a fixed set of four colours with roles (background, accent, secondary accent, text) and one header and body font.
Keep the theme's visual identity consistent on every section and check contrast and readability after applying it.
If no preset fits, write a new named theme in the same format, show it for review, then apply it.

changes: Chose Ocean Depths (calm, trust-building, maritime) as the theme and used only its four colours: Deep Navy #1a2332 page, Teal #2d8b8b accents, Seafoam #a8dadc secondary, Cream #f1faee text and light section.
Set headings in DejaVu Sans Bold and body in DejaVu Sans exactly as the theme file says, rather than picking a trendy display face.
Kept teal for large shapes, rules and icons only, because navy on teal is below 4.5:1; small text and buttons use seafoam or cream on navy (10:1 and above).
Alternated navy and cream sections so the whole page reads as one theme instead of mixing in extra brand colours.
Applied the same Ocean Depths palette to pricing: navy cards for Solo and Group, a cream card with teal border for the featured Clinic plan, so emphasis comes from the theme's own light/dark pair.
Toggle, badge and check icons are built from seafoam, teal and navy tints (mixed from the theme colours) with no outside colours added.
Kept the DejaVu Sans pairing for the large prices and the small billing notes, with weight (bold vs regular) doing the hierarchy work.
Form sits on a cream card over the navy page, inputs use navy borders and a teal focus ring with a seafoam halo, all from the theme.
The theme has no error colour, so the one deliberate exception is a dark red for the two validation messages, paired with an icon and text so it never relies on colour alone.
Checked contrast on every text and background pair of the card (navy on cream is 14.8:1) before finalising.
